name: 10 Contract notice check on uploaded table (demo)

parameters.content:
## Contract notice check on an uploaded table (demo)
The use case of the mass upload: attach `examples/demo-data/contracts-demo.xlsx` in the Werkbank, click **Send rows to n8n…** (workflow 09 stores the rows in Supabase), then call this workflow with the upload ID. It reads the rows, computes every notice deadline and answers with a digest per owner. Nothing is sent or changed.
**Setup:** workflow 09 and its migration, a *Header Auth* credential (header `x-upload-token`) on this webhook, the environment variables `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY`. Test: `curl -X POST <production url> -H 'x-upload-token: …' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"batchId":"<upload id>"}'`.
Optional: `asOf` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `withinDays` (1-365, default 30). In production, add a Schedule Trigger and a Teams or mail step after *Check deadlines*.
